c0672: Ask for catering experience. Estimated taxes are due quarterly; move a share of every event retainer into a tax savings account so the bill never surprises you.
c0688: Bring your EIN letter and formation documents. Keep a card for purchases and a separate account for event retainers, so client money never mixes with personal money.
